per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The website should have an intuitive and clear interface, making it obvious where to click.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The website should be simple enough for novice users, such as the stakeholder's aunt, to use on their phone.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The sign-up process should be quick and not confusing, with a few simple pages rather than one long page.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should only have to navigate through a maximum of 4 pages to create an account with the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The sign-up process should not ask for too much information upfront, such as billing address and phone number.
The website should have a visible Privacy Policy link near the sign-up button and in the footer on every page.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: After logging in, the website should display big thumbnails of movies or favorites right up front, without hiding them under layers of menus.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should be able to access their streaming movies in under 2 clicks after logging into the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The website should allow users to find a movie, buy it, and start watching within three minutes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The payment processing time should not exceed fifteen seconds before showing a reassuring message.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The website should start playback within ten seconds of pressing the Play button.
The website should handle buffering by telling the user what's happening in simple words and possibly lowering the quality automatically if the internet is slow.
The website should have a high availability target, such as ninety-nine point five percent.
The website should reassure users about card safety by stating that payment details are encrypted and only certain staff can access them.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The website should not display full card numbers, only the last few digits.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The website should have friendly, plain-language error messages that explain what went wrong and what the user can do next.
The website should offer chat support for quick issues and email support for longer issues.
The website should have a short guided tour or a simple 'How it works' overlay for first-time users.
The website should have big Play/Pause and back buttons on the player.
The website should allow users to easily turn on subtitles.
The website should resume playback where the user left off if they get distracted.
